title: Grateful Dead Live at Seminole Indian Village on 1969-05-23
source: Master Soundboard Reels > 1st generation reels > 2nd generation reels > PCM (Sony HG beta tape)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the legendary 5/23/69 Florida show, highlighted by a scorching Dark Star that powers the whole performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this infamous May 23 1969 concert, especially the Dark Star that rolls straight into St. Stephen with fierce energy. The board recording streams cleanly and balances well, giving listeners a clear window onto the raw, high‑volume vibe of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 5‑star, praising both the musical performance and the board recording; no negatives were mentioned, indicating an exceptional show with excellent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced board capture; reviewers note no issues and appreciate streaming it on a good stereo setup.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is raw and high‑energy, with the band pushing volume; while some moments feel a bit forced, the overall flow is driven by the feral intensity of the era and capped by a memorable Dark Star > St. Stephen sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's guitar work on Dark Star is described as spirited, impressive, and full of snarling, popping energy.
